whyItMatters: Insecure.SHA1.hash computes SHA-1 in swift, whose collisions defeat security reliance on the digest.
actions: Replace Insecure.SHA1.hash with SHA256.hash wherever the digest protects signatures or untrusted data.
For remaining compatibility uses, add a comment stating SHA-1 is intentional.
Re-run the scan and confirm every remaining hit carries that justification.
verification: Rescan shows no unjustified Insecure.SHA1.hash, and security digests verify under the replacement.
